why: Stations with a reduced sales tax / broker fee (CCP news 'Fractured Skies in Focus', screenshots 2026-10-28). factor = share of the normal tax you pay there (0.5 = half). orders.py raises the bids in that station so the usual price x (1 - tax) math nets price x (1 - tax x factor). Active from 'from' to 'until' (inclusive). 'from' is a guess (Fractured Skies launch): if the sell window in that station already shows the lower tax, set 'from' to today.
